upcoming.title: 10/2 Restoration Fridays at Forest Park
upcoming.body:
Join NYC Parks and The Forest Park Trust for Restoration Fridays this fall to engage in hands-on forest restoration work, including invasive species removal, trail restoration, and possible planting in our park.

Advance registration is required with the link here. Please wear sturdy, closed toe shoes and clothes you don't mind getting dirty.

Meeting at Buddy Monument

upcoming.title: City of Forest Day: Forest Restoration Walk
upcoming.body:
On City of Forest Day, join the Urban Park Rangers, Forest Park Trust, and Natural Areas Conservancy on a hike to learn some forest health assessment skills. After the hike, put those skills to work removing problem plant species, improving trails, and planting native plants!

Registration with the link here. Registration is required to attend.

Meeting at Myrtle Avenue and Park Lane South

upcoming.title: Man Forever Oak Ridge Concert
upcoming.body:
Queens New Work Fund Grant Recipient John Colpitts presents a new composition with his percussion ensemble Man Forever. 

This event is made possible, in part, with public funds from the Queens Arts Fund, a re-grant program supported by New York City Department of Cultural Affairs in partnership with the City Council and administered by New York Foundation for the Arts.

upcoming.title: 10/9 Restoration Friday at Highland Park
upcoming.body:
Join NYC Parks and The Forest Park Trust as we steward a vernal pool! Volunteers will get to take part in invasive species removal and protecting planted native species.

Advance registration is required with the link here. All tools will be provided, and no prior experience is needed. Just bring your enthusiasm. Please come dressed in sturdy, closed-toe shoes, long pants and bring your own water bottle.

Meeting at the Vermont Place Parking Lot

upcoming.title: Help the Garden Day at Highland Park Community Garden
upcoming.body:
Join community gardeners at Highland Park Community Garden for their monthly Help the Garden Day event! Learn about this beautiful space and help keep it thriving. Tasks may include weeding communal beds, composting, and more. 

Email highlandparkcommunitygarden@gmail.com for more information.

past.title: Rising Vibes Group Yoga at Upper Highland Park
past.body:
Join NYC Parks and Maya Eberhart, founder of Rising Vibes Yoga, for a free one-hour yoga class on Tuesday, September 29.

Open to all levels— be ready to move, breathe, and reconnect with yourself in an uplifting community setting at Highland Park.
Bring your yoga mat, water, and an open mind, and get ready to flow. 

Register here to secure your spot!
